authors: Petra Černá, Steven Dow, Jennifer Hawley, McKenna Willis, Michael R Lappin
journal: Journal of Feline Medicine and Surgery

mcqs.q: Oral molnupiravir given to cats with naturally occurring FIP achieved what 6-month survival rate?
mcqs.e: 77% of the 73 enrolled cats survived to 6 months.

mcqs.q: What was the effect of adding the oral immune stimulant (LTC) to molnupiravir?
mcqs.e: No effects of the LTC were apparent in this study.

mcqs.q: How were the 12% of cats that relapsed managed?
o: All achieved remission with a second course of treatment
Switched to a different antiviral class
mcqs.e: Relapses occurred in 12% and all achieved remission during a second course.

authors: Kyle L Granger, Chase Gross, Chad Frank, Michael R Lappin

mcqs.q: How was highly pathogenic avian influenza (H5N1) confirmed in this cat's brain and lung tissue?
mcqs.e: Influenza A/H5 was confirmed in brain and pulmonary tissues by real-time RT-PCR.

mcqs.q: What exposure feature did this case highlight as novel?
o: Known contact with an infected cat
A predominantly indoor cat with minimal outdoor access
mcqs.e: Infection occurred in a largely indoor cat, supporting indirect environmental contamination or transport hosts.

mcqs.q: What was the outcome for this cat?
mcqs.e: Despite aggressive supportive care the cat deteriorated and was humanely euthanized.

authors: Friederike Krämer, Gad Baneth, Filipe Dantas-Torres, Sarah Hamer, Michael R Lappin, Domenico Otranto, Xavier Roura, Heinz Sager, Bettina Schunack, Valeria Scorza, Rebecca Traub, Timothy G Geary

mcqs.q: What is the central conclusion of this review?
o: Resistance only matters in livestock parasites
Antiparasitic resistance is an emerging concern in companion-animal ectoparasites, helminths, and protozoa
Resistance eliminates the need for parasite prevention
mcqs.e: The review establishes drug resistance as an emerging issue across companion-animal parasite groups.

mcqs.q: Historically, which group received the most attention for antiparasitic resistance?
mcqs.e: Intensive treatment of livestock parasites drove most prior resistance research; companion animals were neglected.

authors: Petra Černá, Luke Wittenburg, Jennifer Hawley, McKenna Willis, Britta Siegenthaler, Michael R Lappin

mcqs.q: For therapeutic drug monitoring of molnupiravir in FIP cats, which compound should be measured?
mcqs.e: NHC, the active metabolite, should be measured because MPV is rapidly converted to it.

mcqs.q: Why were parent MPV serum concentrations low?
o: Rapid conversion to active metabolite NHC
mcqs.e: Low MPV levels reflect fast conversion to NHC.

mcqs.q: What did twice-daily dosing for 7 days show regarding serum drug levels?
mcqs.e: Minimal drug accumulation was seen in trough concentrations with twice-daily dosing.

authors: Petra Černá, Marieke Knies, Marleen Assink, Samantha Evans, Séverine Tasker, Danièlle A Gunn-Moore, Katrin Hartmann, Katharina Buchta, Samantha Taylor, Solène Meunier, Regina Hofmann-Lehmann, Nicole Jacque, Allison Koonce, Casandra Jacobs, Ashley Gillett, Michael R Lappin

mcqs.q: In cats with FIP-associated immune-mediated hemolytic anemia, the anemia was most often:
mcqs.e: Anemia was non-regenerative in 80% of the cats.

mcqs.q: What was the survival rate of these cats treated with antivirals plus glucocorticoids?
mcqs.e: At last follow-up 33 of 45 cats (73%) had survived.

mcqs.q: Which finding was present concurrently in 40% of these cats?
mcqs.e: Concurrent thrombocytopenia was present in 18 (40%) cats.

authors: Domenico Otranto, Mariaelisa Carbonara, Gad Baneth, Filipe Dantas-Torres, Michael R Lappin, Vanessa R Barrs

mcqs.q: Why have feline vector-borne diseases historically been understudied?
o: Cats were assumed less susceptible than dogs
No arthropod vectors feed on cats
mcqs.e: Research was hampered by the belief that cats are less susceptible than dogs.

mcqs.q: According to this review, what aspects of feline vector-borne diseases does it update?
o: Their geographical distribution, clinical features, diagnosis, treatment, and prevention
The cost of pet health insurance
mcqs.e: The review updates the current geographical distribution of FVBDs along with their clinical features, diagnosis, treatments, and prevention measures.

mcqs.q: What does the review say about the zoonotic role of cats?
o: Cats can harbor zoonotically important vector-borne pathogens
mcqs.e: The review highlights the zoonotic importance of feline vector-borne pathogens.

mcqs.q: Which pathogen was common in dogs and their ticks/fleas in this Guatemalan community?
mcqs.e: Ehrlichia (E. canis) was amplified from 60% of dogs and from their ticks and fleas.

mcqs.q: What were the Bartonella results in the human and dog blood samples?
o: Negative in all human and dog samples
mcqs.e: All human and dog blood samples were negative for Bartonella.

mcqs.q: What does this One Health study illustrate?
o: Dogs and ectoparasites serve as reservoirs for vector-borne zoonoses
mcqs.e: It shows dogs and their ectoparasites as reservoirs for vector-borne zoonoses in resource-limited areas.

journal: Journal of the American Veterinary Medical Association

mcqs.q: What was the 2024 median salary for full-time clinical shelter medicine veterinarians?
mcqs.e: Full-time clinical vets reported a median salary of $122,500, a 25% increase since 2018.

mcqs.q: Which category of shelter veterinarian earned the highest median income?
mcqs.e: Leadership/consulting roles earned the most at a median of $168,000.

mcqs.q: How did shelter clinical salaries compare with private/companion-animal practice?
mcqs.e: Clinical salaries were 5% lower than private practice and 7% lower than companion-animal practice.

mcqs.q: Which was a key ASV objection to the 2024 WSAVA reproduction guidelines?
o: Recommending early spay for all dogs
A blanket recommendation not to spay large dogs
mcqs.e: The ASV objected to the controversial blanket recommendation not to spay large dogs.

mcqs.q: What underlying position does the ASV critique reflect?
o: Support for accessible spay-neuter with population/health benefits
mcqs.e: The ASV reinforces accessible/HQHVSN spay-neuter and the health/population benefits of sterilization.

mcqs.q: What additional concerns did the ASV raise about the guidelines?
o: Bias against low-income owners and promotion of untested, high-cost practices
mcqs.e: Concerns included bias against low-income owners and promotion of untested/high-cost practices.

mcqs.q: How does H3N2 canine influenza virus behave in dense kennel and shelter populations in North America?
o: Spreads very rapidly then dies out locally
mcqs.e: The virus spreads rapidly among dogs in dense kennels/shelters but then dies out locally.

mcqs.q: What is required to maintain H3N2 CIV outbreaks over the long term?
mcqs.e: Sustained outbreaks depend on long-distance dispersal and repeated reintroductions (recently from China).

mcqs.q: Where did H3N2 canine influenza virus originate?
mcqs.e: H3N2 CIV emerged from an avian reservoir in Asia and has circulated in dogs for ~20 years.

mcqs.q: What did a single preoperative dose of gabapentin (20 mg/kg) achieve in shelter cats undergoing ovariohysterectomy?
o: Elimination of the need for anesthesia
mcqs.e: There was no difference between gabapentin and placebo for any outcome measure.

mcqs.q: What is the clinical implication of these findings?
o: Dedicated multimodal analgesia is still required
mcqs.e: Gabapentin alone did not provide analgesia, so multimodal analgesia remains necessary.

mcqs.q: What was the rescue analgesia requirement in the study?
o: No cat in either group required rescue analgesia
mcqs.e: No cat required rescue analgesia at any time point.

mcqs.q: What survival rate did GS-441524 achieve in this 629-cat FIP cohort?
mcqs.e: The survival rate reached 94.12% with only 0.63% relapse.

mcqs.q: Which finding was associated with reduced survival (negative prognostic factor)?
mcqs.e: Fever, icterus, anemia, and low platelet count were major risk factors for lower survival.

mcqs.q: What did neurological and mixed/ocular forms of FIP require for treatment?
mcqs.e: Neurological/mixed forms required higher doses, raised to about 12.7 mg/kg.
